en.text:
Grants Lightweight Frame bonuses.

Only the Poision Burst is intrinsically <overload/>Anti-Overload. Regular arrows do not stun Champions. 

Arrows released within the Perfect Draw window apply poison on hit. Poison deals <pve 70 /> <pvp [2.5] /> damage every 0.25 seconds for 1.35 seconds, totalling <pve 420 /> <pvp [15] /> damage.

Precision Hits within the Perfect Draw window trigger a burst of poison in a 5 meter radius around the target.
